Synopsis:
Players emerge from a seemingly abandoned crypt, startling a bandit on the other side of the door. Afterward, the bandit attacks.

Cluster Contexts:
- CHA_Outside_BanditBackInteraction_Spotted.json: Right outside of the abandonned chapel of Selune you encounter a few bandits arguing among themselves. They are rightfully surprise to see you get out of the ruins and worried about the fate of their friend inside.
- LOW_KurwinCoffin_KoboldLooter.json: Automatically initiated dialogue after players bash/prise open a coffin with Bugthimble, a tetchy and mistrustful Kobold, just trying to live her best life looting the coffin and the nasty adventurers dug her upt! She wears a face covering helmet.Players have either dug here expecting to find "Enough valuables to settle matters between us" as the note they found said (Tough letter, found on the Courier by Scratch) or just decided to dig up a grave for fun.
- CRE_ChainOfCommand_CultistsCapture.json: The player sees two Githyanki guards dragging three cultists in the monastery. One of the cultists - upon realising they're looking for some sort of weapon and failing to plead ignorance - makes a break for it. The gith guard kills him. The guards order the two remaining inside, pointing at the gate, before cutting to gameplay.
- CHA_Outside_BanditWestInteraction.json: Alternate version of the confrontation scene between Gimblebock and his bandits at the crypt - triggers if the player approaches the scene from the side, alerting Warryn first.
- SHA_Necromancer_Barricade.json: The player is challenged by some skeleton warriors at a barricade outside the Necromancer's lair. The necromancer speaks through the dead warriors - his words in their dessicated voices.(this mayor may not follow on from an earlier scene with more skeletons controlled by the necromancer). A mindmeld convinces the necromancer to command his skeletons to grant entry. The scene ends with combat with the skeletons, or a shadowquake triggering a fight between player (+ skeletons) against sharran wraiths. Afterwards, the player is invited into Balthazar's inner sanctum.

context: You and your party have just come out of a seemingly abandoned crypt/chapel of Selûne; Mari is frightened and blurts out that something’s emerging as you step into daylight. Outside the door a small bandit group is already gathered and arguing, having been startled by your sudden appearance and worried about whatever (or whoever) was inside. That surprise quickly escalates into violence when one of the bandits lashes out and attacks the party. (There are alternate approach variants and nearby scenes that can change details — e.g., a kobold looter in a coffin, nearby cultist/Githyanki activity, or necromantic defenses — but those are separate triggers and not shown in this excerpt.)
